value.name: Southern California Edison (SCE)
value.notes: Western Community Energy (WCE), the only CCA ever formed to serve inland Southern California, deregistered with the CPUC and dissolved via Chapter 9 bankruptcy in 2021. Its own now-stale website (frozen since its original 2020 launch announcement) confirms its service area was limited to only six Riverside County cities (Norco, Perris, Wildomar, Jurupa Valley, Hemet, Eastvale) and never included any San Bernardino County city. No other CCA was found serving San Bernardino County in this dataset's research. SCE is recorded as both the distribution and generation utility.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Victorville.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value.name: Checklist published on the City's website, completed and submitted with the application
Standard engineering evaluation verifying the support structure is adequate for wind/seismic/dead/live loads
Verification the existing electrical system (line, load, ground, bonding, panel/subpanel sizing) can carry the new PV load

required_documents.notes: Per Victorville Municipal Code Title 16, Chapter 5, Article 19 (Small Residential Rooftop Solar Energy System Review Process), Section 16-5.19.010.

value: Inspections are scheduled online via the City's Citizen Self Service Portal, with a choice of morning (8am-12pm) or afternoon (1pm-5pm, 1pm-4pm on Fridays) preference
Inspections are conducted Monday-Friday; to cancel, call the Building Division at (760) 955-5100
inspection_steps.notes: This is the City's general Building Division inspection process (the same page covers all building permit types, including solar); the City does not publish a separate, solar-specific inspection sequence.
